title: Wholemeal Pitta Bread
description: Simple yeasted wholemeal pitta breads, kneaded and proved before being cooked in a hot dry pan until puffed and lightly charred.
ingredients: 350g (12.5oz) strong wholemeal bread flour, plus extra for dusting
steps: In a small bowl or jug, dissolve the yeast and sugar in the warm water. Leave for 5 minutes until it starts to foam.
In a large bowl, mix together the flour and salt. Pour in the yeast mixture and olive oil and mix to form a dough. Knead for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough back in the bowl, cover with a damp tea towel and leave in a warm place to prove for 1 hour until doubled in size.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces. Roll each out on a lightly floured surface into an oval shape, about 5mm thick.
Heat a dry frying pan or griddle over a high heat and cook each pitta for 2-4 minutes on each side until puffed and lightly charred in spots. Serve warm.
notes: Perfect with soups such as Spiced Leek & Potato (p.141) and Spiced Tomato, Lentil & Chickpea (p.134). Also great with the Fakeaway Doner Kebab (p.169). Prep time excludes the 1-hour proving time.
